scripts.content:pull: shopify theme pull -e content --live --only templates/*.json --only templates/customers/*.json --only sections/*.json --only config/settings_data.json --force
scripts.content:seed-dev: npm run content:pull && shopify theme push -e content --development --nodelete --only templates/*.json --only templates/customers/*.json --only sections/*.json --only config/settings_data.json
scripts.content:pull:dev: shopify theme pull -e content --development --only templates/*.json --only templates/customers/*.json --only sections/*.json --only config/settings_data.json --force
